dict.string: 15-min cache-write walker for /cold-storage "locked" figure. Sums EscrowCreate objects across the category=ripple cohort (minus RLUSD issuer) via LAN rippled and upserts one aggregate row into the singleton escrow_supply_snapshot in Neon. The /cold-storage route reads from the table instead of making 19 paginated account_objects RPCs per page render. Wired 2026-09-03 to kill ~52/hr walker_node_fallback rows for a total that changes once a month. Same 15-min cadence + StartInterval discipline as cold_storage_walker.
